item.title: South Broadway theater in Denver exits bankruptcy, foreclosure
item.description: The Jewel Theater on South Broadway in Denver has avoided foreclosure and exited bankruptcy after Sonquist LLC reached terms with its lender.

item.title: Grading The Week: Memo to Broncos: Please don’t forget parking for fans at Burnham Yard
item.description: No one's expecting the new Broncos stadium to be a free ride for the populace. But we are pleading to the Walton-Penner group to at save Broncomaniacs a place to park their rides on gameday.

item.title: One killed in shooting on West Maple Avenue in Denver
item.description: One person was killed and another was injured in a shooting in Denver's Valverde neighborhood early Saturday morning, police said.

item.title: Deputy fired after DUI arrest, Douglas County sheriff says
item.description: A Douglas County deputy was fired after he was arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence, assault, careless driving and obstructing a peace officer, the sheriff's office said.

item.title: Tennessee business leaders among four killed in Colorado plane crash
item.description: Two Tennessee businessmen were among the four people killed when a plane crashed in the Colorado mountains near Steamboat Springs on Friday, according to the Routt County Coroner's Office.

item.title: Aggressive CU Buffs rout BYU in women’s basketball
item.description: There were plenty of numbers Saturday that were impressive for the Colorado women’s basketball team. What might have impressed head coach JR Payne the most, however, was the number of times her players dove to the floor or fought for rebounds during a 76-46 rout of BYU at the CU Events Center.

item.title: No. 22 BYU turns away Colorado’s upset bid
item.description: Brigham Young immortalized a program all-timer by retiring the No. 32 jersey of former Cougars sharpshooter Jimmer Fredette. Colorado shook off its recent road doldrums and did its best to ruin the party.

item.title: CSU Rams rally past Wyoming in final minutes to claim home Border War victory
item.description: With the win, the Rams improved to 15-10 overall and 6-8 in the Mountain West Conference
